independence: Reviewer authored H2 and package A, but did not author H1 or H3. This receipt independently covers the H1/H3 delta, not H2 or the complete package C.
scope: Hardware scanner normalization and isolated scanner test; manual POS commands, Enter/Tab handling, duplicate submission and IME guards.
Hardware settings snapshot/legacy mapping, audited save integration, receipt profiles, bounded single-flight queue diagnostics and native buffer limits.
Physical test service fail-closed permission/actor checks after asynchronous discovery and immediately before intercepted printer/drawer effects.
Display settings and privacy projection, bounded local logo loading/import, unsaved synthetic preview, finite test pattern, actor fencing and live committed settings reload.
Display timer/window cleanup, initially minimized expiry, focus preservation and regression smoke source for the resolved findings.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Existing explicit quantity and numeric CLP command paths run before strict scanner normalization. Remaining barcode input is validated; a rejected scan cannot reach quick-create.
resolvedFindings.regression: HardwareSettingsSmoke checks affixed scanning, duplicate submission, rejected scan, 2*barcode, selected-line =3 and numeric CLP 1500.

resolvedFindings.resolution: UI handlers capture the original operator in the permission demand. Both output test services deny missing callbacks and repeat permission and safe-start checks after awaited discovery, before IReceiptPrinter output.
resolvedFindings.regression: HardwareSettingsSmoke holds fake inventory discovery, changes actor and requires zero intercepted effects; a held authorization allows one fake receipt effect.

resolvedFindings.resolution: StartPreview starts the expiry timer before TryOpenOrUpdate can return for an already minimized cashier window. Duration remains bounded to 5-60 seconds and expiry restores runtime state and cleans up the timer.
resolvedFindings.regression: CustomerDisplayPolishSmoke checks visible and initially minimized five-second patterns, no real sale projection in synthetic content, restoration, window/timer cleanup and subscription cleanup.

resolvedFindings.resolution: A meaningful receipt queue change clears drawer test observation and confirmation when the drawer uses that receipt fallback. Comparison trims names and ignores case; an explicit drawer target is preserved.
resolvedFindings.regression: HardwareSettingsSmoke confirms drawer queue A, changes fallback to B and requires configured-needs-test plus disabled confirmation.

checks: Queue health reports configuration/observation rather than certifying physical output from native queue availability alone.
Diagnostics are single-flight even after caller timeout; native inventory/diagnostic buffers and enumerated jobs are bounded; no purge or cancel is introduced.
Receipt profile paper choices use measured width; drawer commands use bounded supported ESC/POS kick bytes.
Display privacy suppresses paid/change strings when disabled and masks reserved/manual identifiers; last-four mode uses text elements.
Logo policy validates encoded byte and decoded pixel bounds before detached image decoding; managed local files are hash checked and paths/device identifiers are not exported through diagnostics.
Preview/test content uses validated unsaved settings and synthetic content, does not persist a sale/settings mutation, and restores current projection after stop/expiry.
Settings save permission callbacks bind the original actor and are rechecked before transactional commit; committed settings notifications refresh runtime snapshots.
Dispose/close paths stop timers and unsubscribe settings/display callbacks.
